headline: Local Chai Stall Owner Confirms Recent World Leader Meeting Was Actually Just Two Guys Asking For Extra Ginger
body:
An unassuming tea stall owner in New Delhi clarified today that the high-stakes diplomatic meeting between regional heads of state, which international analysts spent 48 hours dissecting, was actually just a brief, mundane discussion regarding the quantity of ginger in their cutting chai.

“The gentleman in the suit and his counterpart were not discussing bilateral trade corridors or regional security frameworks,” said 54-year-old stall operator Rameshwar Singh, while vigorously stirring a pot of boiling milk. “They were simply debating whether a third sliver of ginger would make the tea ‘too spicy’ or ‘authentically aromatic.’ It was a heated argument, but it was about the ginger, not the sanctions.”

Global geopolitical commentators had previously flooded television screens with maps and flowcharts, speculating that the handshake captured on camera signaled a shift in global power dynamics. Singh, however, insists the only thing shifting was the crowd of commuters waiting behind the two leaders for their own orders.

“I told them both that if they wanted to discuss global alliances, they could do it while standing near the bin like everyone else,” Singh added. “They ended up settling for two cups of extra-sweet chai and a packet of Marie biscuits, paid for with a crumpled five-hundred rupee note that I had to hunt for change for. There was no deal, only a very satisfied appetite.”
caption: Forget the geopolitical theories, the real summit took place at the local tapri. Turns out the only thing on the table was a double-ginger debate. #Geopolitics #ChaiDiplomacy #IndiaIran #InternationalRelations (satire)
